title: feat(spec)!: the action blocks spell the destructive variant `danger`, the word ActionSchema.variant uses
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQfjnJWXwANqb5TscsSvrHR)_

Fixes #26779

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` (outside the generated references) or `ui/content/**` teaches an action block's `variant`; the generated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is regenerated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:四个 action 区块(`action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu` 及其成员)的 `variant` 把 `destructive` 改名为 `danger`,与 `ActionSchema.variant` 同一个拼法;旧值保存时拒收并给出改名提示,存量页面由 ADR-0087 转换自动改写。
- 为什么改:同一个危险动作在声明里写 `danger`、在区块里写 `destructive`,两套方言让每个渲染器都要翻译一次;协议只留一个拼法(分诊裁决 6448425754)。
- 风险与回滚:作者写的 `variant: 'destructive'` 区块在下次保存时被拒(收窄,带迁移处方);存量 `page` 行在加载时被转换改写。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`(`ACTION_BLOCK_VARIANTS` 与 `actionBlockVariant`)、`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`(`pageActionBlockVariantDestructiveToDanger`)、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/runner-variant.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/conversions/page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger.test.ts`,预期 35 个用例全绿(六行接受 `danger`、拒收 `destructive` 并给改名提示、存量行被改写)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Spec (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`).** The five rows that read `BUTTON_PRIMITIVE_VARIANTS` (`ActionButtonPropsSchema`, `ActionIconPropsSchema`, the shared group/menu member shape, `ActionGroupPropsSchema`, `ActionMenuPropsSchema`) now read `ACTION_BLOCK_VARIANTS = default | danger | outline | secondary | ghost | link`, plus `primary` on the three rows that took it before. `BUTTON_PRIMITIVE_VARIANTS` had no other reader on `main` `8074feb6`, so it is replaced, not kept beside. Each row builds its enum through `actionBlockVariant(subject, extra)`, whose error map answers `destructive` with the rename onto `danger` (naming the key the author wrote) and leaves every other miss to the enum's own message. That is the established enum-value retirement shape (`FORM_VIEW_LAYOUT_RETIRED`, `OBJECT_FORM_LAYOUT_RETIRED`); it adds no `.refine()`, so no dropped-refinements row. The `.describe()` texts say `danger` and what it does.

**Data at rest.** ADR-0087 D2 conversion `page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger` (`toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, order 77). It rewrites `properties.variant` on the four block nodes and `variant` on each `action:group` / `action:menu` member, at every position `mapPageComponents` visits. Every other component (`element:button` keeps the primitive's `destructive`) and every other value is left as stored. D3 entry `ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused`. One JOIN row in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` (six refusals; the pin derives `@objectstack/spec 18` and `--from 17` from `retiredAfter`).

**ui renderers.** `runner-variant.ts` now holds two closed maps and neither reads `destructive`: `toRunnerVariant` forwards `danger | primary | secondary | ghost | link` as they are (and nothing for `default` / `outline`), and `toButtonVariant` draws `danger` as the primitive's `destructive` and `primary` as `default`. The four renderers draw through `toButtonVariant`, and the group/menu dropdown items paint red on `danger`. The designer inputs of `action:button` and `action:icon` list `danger` in place of `destructive`, and `sdui.manifest.json` is regenerated (two enum values). `UIActionSchema.variant` follows the rows by reference, so its doc comment is rewritten.

**The #26776 bridge is removed, not kept.** It existed because stored and authored blocks said `destructive` while the runner reads `danger`. After this PR the rows refuse `destructive` at save, a page's next save meets the component-props gate, and every data-at-rest seam (`applyConversionsToStoredItem` for stored `page` rows, the artifact door inside its declared-floor window, `os migrate meta --write` for sources) replays the conversion, retired entries included. So no stored page reaches a renderer with `destructive`, and AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12 leaves no room for a consumer-side alias kept "just in case".

**Authored values converted.** No `examples/**`, `apps/**`, `packages/platform-objects/**`, `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` source writes `variant: 'destructive'` on an action block (measured with a `git grep` over `variant` + `destructive` at `8074feb6`; every hit there is a React `Button`/`Alert` primitive or a `type: 'button'` component). The authored ones are in `ui/`: the record detail views' code-built Delete entry for the `⋯` menu (`RecordDetailView.tsx`, `plugin-detail` `DetailView.tsx`), the `action-bar.tsx` doc example, and the test fixtures below.

**VS Code extension.** `ui/packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/SchemaValidator.ts` judges the action block variants against the block rows (`danger` accepted, `destructive` answered with the rename; `primary` on the rows that take it). The `button` component's list, which is the Button primitive's and keeps `destructive`, is untouched. The package is private, so it needs no changeset.

**Changeset** `.changeset/26779-action-block-variant-danger.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` minor, with the FROM → TO prescription, both declaration lines and the `registered` ADR-0087 marker, plus a paragraph that supersedes the variant sentences of the pending #26665 entry.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/conversions/page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger.test.ts` (35 cases): the six rows accept `danger`; refuse `destructive` with the rename at `variant` / `actions.0.variant`; CONTROL, another miss keeps the enum message; the stored-row seam rewrites all four nodes and a member alone (copy-on-write for the other); six controls left as stored; canonical page returns the same reference; idempotent; the authoring funnel does not replay it.
- Updated fixtures to the new spelling: spec `component-report-items-action-members-typed.pin.test.ts` (two members), ui `action-group-menu-inputs-11168.test.tsx` (two members, same assertions: `bg-destructive` and `text-destructive`), `action-variant-confirm-26665.test.tsx` (the four blocks confirm through the destructive button on `danger`; new `toButtonVariant` rows; CONTROL rows that `destructive` is no longer read), and one `pins:` sentence in `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Claim wording.** The claim asks for "an `aliases` prescription". `strictObject`'s `aliases` maps unknown KEYS to known ones; a renamed VALUE has no key to alias, so the prescription lives in the enum's error map, the shape the other enum-value retirements use.
- **File surface beyond the claim, each forced:** `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `plugin-detail` `DetailView.tsx` (their Delete entry would lose its red row once the menus paint on `danger`), `@object-ui/types` `ui-action.ts` (doc comment of the by-reference type), `sdui.manifest.json` + `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (the registry-change regeneration; the record's `objectuiWorkspaceVersion` moves 18.1.0 → 18.2.0 because main's record trailed the version label), the D3 entry and the JOIN row (both red without them, as on the locale retirement).
- **Unchanged on purpose.** The page-header tests still give the host's `sys_delete` fixture `variant: 'destructive'`: the header judges destructiveness by `variant === 'danger' || name === 'sys_delete'`, and that fixture is the by-name control. `ActionPreview.tsx` previews an `ActionSchema`, not a block.
- **Unreleased #26665 changeset.** `.changeset/26665-action-block-destructive-confirm.md` (not yet released) describes the bridge this PR removes ("`danger` stays refused there"). It is left byte-identical to the merge base, because editing another card's pending note is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class that keeps `check-empty-changeset` red until a person confirms it. Instead, this PR's changeset carries a paragraph that explicitly replaces that entry's variant sentences in the same release and keeps its confirm-dialog behaviour (seat 1 ruling).
- **Not measurable from here:** stored deployed rows and hotcrm sources. The conversion covers stored `page` rows and built artifacts in their window; a hotcrm source with a `destructive` block meets the refusal on its next `os validate`.

## Verification

Readings on the pre-merge head `22846fae` unless marked; `main` was then merged (`17ecbb46`, 28 commits, none touching a file this PR edits) and the spec artefacts and spec tests below were re-run on the merged head.

<details><summary>Re-measure before any edit (main 8074feb6)</summary>

A `safeParse` probe over the six rows: `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group`, the group member, `action:menu` and the menu member each REFUSE `danger` ("Invalid option: expected one of default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link…") and ACCEPT `destructive`. The premise held on all six. `BUTTON_PRIMITIVE_VARIANTS` had five readers, all action block rows, and no other.
</details>

<details><summary>Spec</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated`: 13/14 up to date, `check:docs` stale; `--fix` rewrote `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, then 14/14 up to date. On the merged head `17ecbb46`: build + `check:generated`, all 14 up to date, nothing to commit.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 739 files, 22139 tests passed (1 todo). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Merged head: `vitest run src/conversions src/migrations src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts src/ui/component-report-items-action-members-typed.pin.test.ts`: 29 files, 1054 tests passed.
</details>

<details><summary>ui</summary>

- Closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --filter @objectstack/formula --filter @objectstack/client`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action` + the three `page-header-*` tests + `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: 40 files, 921 tests passed.
- `type-check` on `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: all four Done, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Reverse check of the by-reference type, against the rebuilt spec `.d.ts`: a scratch file assigning `'destructive'` and `'danger'` to `UIActionSchema['variant']` reds only the first (`TS2322: Type '"destructive"' is not assignable to type '"default" | "link" | "primary" | "secondary" | "danger" | "ghost" | "outline" | undefined'`); the file was then deleted.
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: 106 components; the diff is the two `destructive` → `danger` input enum values.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates and dogfood</summary>

- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 116 families. Run serially: 114 exit 0, `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (prerequisite not built). After the dogfood closure build both exit 0 (267 prose examples type-check; dual-build floors met). `--ran` reconciliation: 116 derived, 116 accounted for.
- Dogfood (`--filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...'` build, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, one lock): VERDICT command-exit 1. Test Files 1 failed, 339 passed, 3 skipped (343); Tests 2 failed, 2752 passed, 20 skipped (2774). Both failures are in `test/packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts` (acceptance 0 and acceptance 5/2). Run alone on the same head it passes 8/8, the load flake already recorded for that file; this diff touches no action-disable path.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0. No exported symbol is renamed or removed (`BUTTON_PRIMITIVE_VARIANTS` was module-private), so `check-platform-checklist` was not owed.
</details>

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
